relationships.evidence_quote: Only the CCI group presented high levels of BDNF in the trigeminal ganglion.

key_findings: CCI-ION in rats induced facial mechanical hyperalgesia that was reversed by phenobarbital and morphine, transiently relieved by diazepam, and attenuated by the NMDA antagonist MK801 at 60 min.
BDNF rose in cortex and brainstem in both CCI-ION and sham groups, but was elevated in the trigeminal ganglion only after CCI-ION, implicating peripheral BDNF in trigeminal neuropathic pain.
